title: FireFront 1.2
description: FireFront is about your own fun and relaxing gameplay. Mod let a player to fast skip earlygame and make midgame easier.
body:
The new 1.2 update RBGFront include a lot of colours themed items and mechanics: decorative blocks, weapons and... CCG??

FireFront is about your own fun and relaxing gameplay. Mod let a player to fast skip earlygame and make midgame easier. There is not a lot content now, but it is enough for your modpack.
Mod feature few structures, mobs, tools, weapons, blocks and crafts. They let player a new ways to begin new survival. Try it yourself.
![Build an empire](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e67b9bd6f9276708d939f0a4fbdf58b3f9732b5.png)
Also good in kingdom roleplay with friends.

Join discord to stay tuned.

Mod languages: English, Русский
